Population increased in Lincoln

The estimated population of Lincoln in 2024 was 105,114 usual residents, a rise of 1.0% since 2023.

This meant that Lincoln's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Lincoln increased by 2.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Lincoln was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Lincoln

The average (median) age rose to 34.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Lincoln has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Lincoln is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Lincoln's population of 105,114 usual residents was made up of:

  • 16,987 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.2%)
  • 72,252 people aged 16 to 64 years, (68.7%)
  • 15,875 people aged 65 years and over, (15.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Lincoln has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (68.7% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Lincoln, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Lincoln
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Lincoln, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 15 people (0%). In total, there were 945 births and 960 deaths in Lincoln.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 1,335 (-1.3%). There were 11,118 people entering the area and 12,453 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Lincoln's population of 2,389 (2.3%) as a result of 3,394 people entering the area and 1,005 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Lincoln was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Lincoln in mid-2023 is 104,122.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 971 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 163 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 808 people.
